# Assets · Logos

3 files under `assets/Logos/`, held in the artifact’s asset store: fetch one with the Artifact tool’s `read`, the id below as `path` (they are not files beside the page — a read by file path fails), then upload it to your own artifact as an asset (`publish`, `asset:true`; or `upload_asset`, where your tool lists that); an SVG may also be inlined. Copy assets, never approximate them.

## Use

```html
<img src="<the url the asset upload returned for gathr-wordmark-light.svg>" alt="…">
```

## Usage notes

# Logos

The gathr wordmark (option J76): Plus Jakarta Sans Bold outlines tracked −6%, plus one true circle after the r. See the Logo section of the brand book for the construction.

- `gathr-wordmark-light.svg`: letters night-50 (#f7f5f0), dot yellow-300. For dark grounds, blooms and photos.
- `gathr-wordmark-dark.svg`: letters night-950 (#0a0a0a), dot violet-500. For light paper and -300 colour fields.
- `gathr-wordmark-mono-white.svg`: all white. For one-ink merch, embossing and knock-outs.
